_about: Inputs to the OpenAI / Anthropic token-volume estimator that cannot be fetched. Every value carries a source, an as-of date and a confidence. They are the argument, so the panel prints them and you can correct them — nothing here is measured, and the panel says so. `confidence`: high = named figure from a filing or an on-record executive statement; medium = reported by a credible outlet and corroborated; low = my inference, treat as a placeholder and replace. Written 2026-09-17 against a model whose knowledge runs to May 2026, so anything dated after that is explicitly marked stale-risk and should be the first thing you refresh.
knowledgeCutoffWarning: Seeded by a model with a May 2026 cutoff. Revenue run-rates and fleet sizes move fast; treat every 2026 figure below as a placeholder until you have replaced it from a primary source.

assumptions.h100TokensPerSecondNote: left null on purpose — read live from the GPU economics feed (InferenceX, gpt-oss-120B at the 50 tok/s/user floor) so the ceiling moves as software improves.
assumptions.consumerApiSplitNote: ChatGPT and Claude.ai token volume is not visible to any method here except the physics ceiling. Panel reports an API series (defensible) and a total band (wide).
assumptions.quarterlyRecognitionNote: fraction of remaining performance obligation recognised per year, used to turn a backlog into an annual compute-spend rate. 0.2 is a placeholder for a ~5-year weighted contract; Oracle and CoreWeave both disclose expected recognition windows in their 10-Qs — replace with the disclosed figure.
assumptions.inferenceShareNote: fraction of a lab's cloud compute spend that serves inference rather than training. The single largest swing factor in method A and almost certainly the least knowable; the panel shows the estimate across a 0.3–0.7 range.
assumptions.attributionNote: Method A only counts a counterparty's backlog where data/ai/token-estimates.json states what share of it belongs to the lab. An unset share contributes nothing — the method reports a smaller number and says which counterparties it had to leave out, rather than silently attributing someone else's bookings.
